text: Part two. In nineteen seventy-one, a man in a dark suit bought a plane ticket, under the name Dan Cooper. Soon after takeoff, he handed the flight attendant a note. He had a bomb. His demands: two hundred thousand dollars, and four parachutes. In Seattle, he let the passengers go, in exchange for the cash, and the plane took off again. Somewhere over the dark forests of Washington, he opened the back stairs, and jumped. He was never seen again. Nine years later, an eight-year-old boy found about five thousand eight hundred dollars of the ransom, buried in the sand by a river. The FBI stopped actively investigating in twenty sixteen. It's still the only unsolved hijacking of its kind. So, did he survive? Tell us what you think. Part three: the diamond vault no one could crack.
